reached_sql:
WITH filtered_date_dim AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_customer_demographics AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_dep_count
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
),
filtered_current_customer_demographics AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c_customer_sk,
        c_current_addr_sk,
        c_birth_year,
        cd2.cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2
        ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
),
filtered_customer_address AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN','GA','MT','IN','CA')
),
filtered_sales_data AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i_item_id,
        ca_country,
        ca_state,
        ca_county,
        cs_quantity,
        cs_list_price,
        cs_coupon_amt,
        cs_sales_price,
        cs_net_profit,
        c_birth_year,
        filtered_customer_demographics.cd_dep_count
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim
        ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN item
        ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_customer_demographics
        ON cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
    JOIN filtered_current_customer_demographics
        ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    JOIN filtered_customer_address
        ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
),
aggregated_results AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i_item_id,
        ca_country,
        ca_state,
        ca_county,
        avg(cast(cs_quantity AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg1,
        avg(cast(cs_list_price AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg2,
        avg(cast(cs_coupon_amt AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg3,
        avg(cast(cs_sales_price AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg4,
        avg(cast(cs_net_profit AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg5,
        avg(cast(c_birth_year AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg6,
        avg(cast(cd_dep_count AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg7
    FROM filtered_sales_data
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county)
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    ca_country,
    ca_state,
    ca_county,
    agg1,
    agg2,
    agg3,
    agg4,
    agg5,
    agg6,
    agg7
FROM aggregated_results
ORDER BY ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
